subtitles.zh: 考虑到目前一些科技股财报后的市场反应，这个观点相当大胆。

subtitles.en: Well, look, so first thing is that earnings reactions have been all over the place in general.
subtitles.zh: 首先，财报后的股价反应整体上差异很大。

subtitles.en: And that's actually typical for an environment where stock correlations are as low as they are.
subtitles.zh: 这在个股相关性较低的时期很常见。

subtitles.zh: 但财报季前，大型科技股空头仓位高，盈利预期强劲，市场情绪却很差。

subtitles.en: And frankly, what we're going to probably find out at the end of this earnings season is that the free cash flow amongst the hyperscalers will cross that zero line.
subtitles.zh: 财报季结束后，超大规模企业的自由现金流可能转正。

subtitles.en: But the market's discounted that already. And so from our point of view, the unloved has upside.
subtitles.zh: 但市场已经消化了这一点，我们认为被冷落的权益资产有上涨空间。

subtitles.en: So you're expecting positive reactions to Google to Nvidia.
subtitles.zh: 所以你预期谷歌和英伟达会有正面反应。

subtitles.zh: 先从Alphabet说起。Alphabet本周晚些时候，应该是明天，发布财报。

results.snippet: # Julian Emanuel. Julian Emanuel is a senior managing director leading the Equity, Derivatives & Quantitative Strategy Team. In 2025, Mr. Emanuel ranked second in the equity-linked strategies category in the annual All-America Research survey by Extel (formerly *Institutional Investor*), marking his third consecutive year placing runner-up or higher. He also earned runner-up recognition in portfolio strategy in both 2024 and 2025. Prior to joining Evercore ISI, Mr. Emanuel was chief equity and derivatives strategist at BTIG with supplemental responsibility for alternative assets and cryptocurrency strategy. Previous roles include chief U.S. equity and derivatives strategist at UBS and portfolio management responsibilities at Tiedemann Investment Group, Goldman Sachs/SLK, and Credit Suisse Asset Management.
